from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyProfit(BaseModel):
    """Extracted 持续经营净利润 from one Q1 financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name, e.g. '格力电器'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal period covered, e.g. '2020 Q1'")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific metric being reported, e.g. '持续经营净利润'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount as a number (without currency symbol)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_profits: list[QuarterlyProfit]
